justifications.type_expressiveness: Uses newtypes for AccountId/TransactionId and an enum for AccountType, but stores AccountType discrimination via plain fields and uses saturating_add silently rather than modeling overflow as a typed concern.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enum with distinguishing variants and Display impl; never panics, but silently saturates on overflow rather than reporting it as an error variant.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Reasonable derives and a Default impl, but no doc comments on any public items and Display for IDs falls back to Debug-style formatting.
justifications.idiomaticity: Generally idiomatic with derives, HashMap, and map(), but uses manual indexed loops instead of iterator methods like .iter().any() or .map().sum() and lacks ? chaining opportunities.
